LESSON: INTERACTIVE SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.7: Interactive Speaking
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Interactive Speaking, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How do you actively participate in a conversation?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. spell out the names of parts of the body (脸、牙、手、头发) with peers,

2. sing the parts of the body song in Chinese collaboratively,

3. say the names of items used for personal grooming (e.g. 水、梳子、牙 膏、牙刷剪刀 etc.),

4. listen to a description and match each body part with the appropriate grooming item used for it (水、梳子、 牙膏、牙刷、剪刀),

5. form simple sentences using vocabulary related to grooming of the body with peers,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. spell out the names of parts of the body (脸、牙、手、头发) with peers,
2. sing the parts of the body song in Chinese collaboratively,
3. say the names of items used for personal grooming (e.g. 水、梳子、牙 膏、牙刷剪刀 etc.),
4. listen to a description and match each body part with the appropriate grooming item used for it (水、梳子、 牙膏、牙刷、剪刀),
5. form simple sentences using vocabulary related to grooming of the body with peers,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Interactive Speaking together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: The learner connects to and uses the internet to search for the importance of personal hygiene practices on

one’s health.

• Learning to learn: The learner works collaboratively with peers to role-play a dialogue on body parts and their appropriate

grooming items.

Values:
Love: The learner exhibits patience when they wait for their turn to form simple sentences using vocabulary related to the theme

with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Personal health and Hygiene: These are developed as the learner appreciates the value of prioritising their health and wellness

through practising good hygiene habits.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links their learning to Agriculture and Nutrition on the concept of practising good personal hygiene habits for

wellness and health.
